name: House Call
summary: One continuous shot from his seat in a bright white home. A nurse walks in, kneels between his legs, rubs his thighs and teases close to his shorts, talking softly the whole time.

start.composition: a wide point-of-view photo from a man seated low on a sofa, his bare knees and thighs and his light grey shorts spread toward the camera at the bottom edge of the frame, she stands a few steps away facing the camera, her whole body in frame, smiling at him
start.outfit: a fitted white nurse mini dress with red trim and a zip front pulled down to show her cleavage
start.setting: bright airy daylight, in a white modern open-plan home with pale oak floors and a white kitchen behind her
start.negative: his face, a second man, extra legs, high angle

legs: she walks toward the camera, smiling, and blows a little kiss
she kneels between his legs and rests her hands on his thighs, talking up at him
she leans in close to his shorts, tongue out playfully, looking up into the camera
she sits back and rubs her hands slowly up and down his thighs
she leans in again with a soft knowing smile, holding eye contact
leg_suffix: handheld point of view from a man seated on a sofa, his knees and thighs fixed at the bottom of the frame, continuous shot, no cuts, smooth natural motion
video_negative: camera cut, scene change, morphing, face change, extra fingers, distorted hands, flicker, different person, his face
script:
[1-6s] Hi. You look tense. Let me help with that.

[12-14s] You feel better already.
